deployments_detail.use: Ascenz Marorka smart-shipping unit uses advanced AI for vessel performance and voyage optimization

AI/machine-learning algorithm (physics-informed 'grey models') developed by subsidiary Ascenz Marorka with GTT to predict LNG sloshing effects - near real-time assessment of pressure loads on tank walls, structural vibrations and boil-off rates, using one of the world's largest hydrodynamic databases. [Ascenz Marorka (GTT Group)]
deployments_detail.value: Navigator Gas reported 15% reduction in consumption and emissions with Ascenz Marorka Smart Shipping tools

deployments_detail.use: Joint study by GTT, Lloyd's Register and Shell using the AI-based Sloshing Virtual Sensor / digital twin to demonstrate predictive technology can safely extend LNG-carrier tank inspection intervals beyond the mandatory 5-year cycle. [GTT / Ascenz Marorka, Lloyd's Register, Shell]

Voyage Insights / Route Optimisation: AI-driven ship models and intelligent navigation algorithms combined with high-resolution weather forecasts and digital twins to give vessel-specific route, speed and shaft-RPM recommendations that cut fuel and emissions. [Ascenz Marorka (GTT Marine)]

Fleet Insights by Kyma: machine-learning digital-twin models grounded in naval architecture and hydrodynamic theory that produce predictive performance benchmarks and predictive alerts when vessels underperform, to reduce emissions. [Danelec / Kyma (GTT Marine)]

Nautilus Labs AI technology platform (acquired via Danelec, now GTT Group): machine-learning plus naval-architecture models delivering real-time voyage-outcome predictions and decarbonisation/efficiency recommendations from millions of data points. [Nautilus Labs (via Danelec / GTT Group)]

TMS Group selected Ascenz Marorka's Smart Shipping platform (advanced AI + naval architecture, VESPER module, LNG Optim, Heel Management, high-frequency sensors) to equip its entire 130+ vessel fleet for performance optimisation and predictive maintenance. [Ascenz Marorka (GTT Group)]

Sloshield real-time sloshing monitoring with predictive analysis contracted to equip 24 LNG carriers at Hudong-Zhonghua Shipbuilding, detecting and reducing sloshing risk in LNG cargo tanks. [Ascenz Marorka (GTT Group)]

Sloshing Virtual Sensor: AI combined with a GTT-designed tank digital twin and real-time operational data to monitor LNG membrane-tank integrity and enable extended, condition-based inspection intervals (predictive maintenance). [GTT / Ascenz Marorka, Approval-in-Principle by Lloyd's Register]

Real-Time Fleet Performance Monitoring Service using AI-driven ship models and intelligent navigation algorithms, operated 24/7 across France, Singapore and (from 2025) the Americas to optimise routes and cut fuel/emissions. [Ascenz Marorka (GTT Group)]
